item.title: 35 million of you have already pre-registered for Arknights: Endfield
item.description: Arknights: Endfield developer Gryphline has a good reason to celebrate, as the upcoming free-to-play action RPG has achieved yet another milestone. The developer announced today that Endfield already has over 35 million pre-registrations. Read more

item.title: Tomorrow's Battlefield 6 patch somehow makes jets more useless, improves armor bar visibility in Redsec
item.description: Battlefield 6’s promised, season-extending update has been officially detailed. The patch, version 1.1.3.5, arrives tomorrow, January 20 right when Season 1 was supposed to end. Part of the update’s goal is to extend the current season, until Season 2 kicks off in the middle of February. Read more

item.title: Heartopia surprise launches on Steam and shockingly, everyone seems to be happy
item.description: Heartopia has officially arrived on Steam, only a little over a week after it launched on iOS and Android. When the game’s release date was announced back in December, developer XD said it was pushing back the Steam release without offering any hints about how long the delay was going to be. Read more

item.title: Battlefield 6’s first big map in months is coming to Labs soon, but I'm more excited about BF4's Golmud Railway making its way to BF6
item.description: Battlefield 6’s Season 2 was recently pushed back by a month to give Battlefield Studios time to polish up its content. Now, the developer has revealed how it plans to use some of that time, and the first port of call is Battlefield Labs. Read more

item.title: Arc Raiders finally reveals early 2026 roadmap, but we’re not getting a new map for a while
item.description: After weeks of waiting, Arc Raiders developer Embark has officially unveiled the first few months of the game’s 2026 roadmap. The plan is split into four months, covering January to April, collectively dubbed Escalation. Read more

item.title: New Super Mario Bros. Wonder amiibo are up for preorder at Amazon
item.description: Super Mario Bros. Wonder getting the Switch 2 Edition + expansion treatment in March feels like Nintendo making the correct call, and I couldn't think of a better game to be getting that bit more attention on the new system. Read more

item.title: Nioh 3’s generous demo is out now, and your progress carries over to the full game
item.description: Nioh 3 is one of the most anticipated games of 2026, and it’s easily among the biggest releases of February. We’re a few days away from the start of that month, however, but we don’t have to wait until then to actually play Team Ninja’s next major release. Read more

item.title: Quantic Dream addresses toxicity, tech bugs and tutorials for Spellcasters Chronicles closed beta 2 - here's how to get a key
item.description: Quantic Dream has opened up its upcoming fantasy MOBA for a second closed beta weekend starting from today, January 29, until 9AM UTC on Monday February 2. Read more

item.title: Infinity Nikki ushers in the Year of the Horse with... a deer-themed Version 2.2
item.description: Infinity Nikki, the free-to-play, open-world dress-up RPG, has delivered yet another big content drop in the form of Chromatic Beings Everbright. The latest update brings the game up to version 2.2, and introduces a new narrative chapter, and gameplay taking place around a festival narrative. Read more

item.title: Zenelss Zone Zero Version 2.6 has you playing as an event planner and social media manager for an idol group
item.description: Zenless Zone Zero’s latest Special Program has delivered a tonne of information about the game’s big upcoming update, Version 2.6. This latest addition kicks off celebrations in New Eridu, and it’s dubbed Encore for an Old Dream. Read more
